newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes in mixed picture.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes in mixed picture.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed mixed on Thursday with foreigners focusing on the steel, cement and oil sectors, traders said.
Brokers forecast a rally on steel companies, expected to take the market up next week.
"Steel industry started to be an attraction for foreign investors," one trader said. "They will rush for it next week."
Gainers matched losers at 103 and 284 stocks closed flat.
The unofficial index VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, climbed by 2.2 percent to 3,870.0 points, while the BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, rose by 3.07 percent to 2,879.7.
Another independent index, CAS-RQ, launched by Creditanstalt Securities earlier this week, was up 3.61 percent to 660 points. All three indices are based on average prices and market capitalisation.
Traders said a special deal in steel mill Otelinox had pushed its closing quote up 3,000 lei to 31,500. The special deal involved 270,000 shares at 32,000 lei per share, a trader said.
"There is growing interest in Otelinox mainly due to a pending 51 percent selloff to a foreign investor," a broker said.
Another steel mill, Sidex, gained 1,400 lei at close to 16,000 under buying pressure.
Oil refinery Petromidia remained among gainers, closing 1,200 lei firmer at 23,000, while refinery Arpechim inched down 100 lei to 26,500.
Cement maker Romcim went up 4,000 lei to end at 79,000.
Turnover rose to 19.6 billion lei from 10.8 billion on Wednesday.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD and CAS-RQ on CASE02. ($=7,231 lei)
